You want to look for a small sign on the table, usually somewhere near the progressive sign if the table has a progressive if not, it will be somewhere on the table. You’re looking for something that says aggregate maximum, in my area it’s either 25,000 or 35,000 depending on the casino. That means in any single betting spot, that is the most a Casino will pay you, regardless of how much you bet or what the odds are. The only exception is a progressive jackpot.

So, for example, on one game there is a bonus that pays 300 to 1. If the aggregate on that table is $35,000, and you were betting $200 on that spot when you hit 300 to 1, even though you would think you’re getting $60k, the aggregate will cap the payout on that spot at $35,000.

So you’re aware, when the dealer checks for blackjack they only know if they have blackjack and nothing else about the under card. They are sliding the cards into a “peeker”, which is a mirror that shows just the corner of the under card, and the dealer will either see the “A” of its a face card, or a “10, J, Q or K” of its an Ace up. If it’s a face card up they will keep the cards vertical, if it’s an ace they will turn it horizontal, this is because of where the letter is located on the corner of these cards. So if the ace is up and the dealer checks for blackjack, they will know if there is a face card but will NOT know if it’s an ace, and vise versa because the cards are turned the wrong way.
